notes.agentPrompt: The field is prefilled with the active profile's default prompt; save to apply your edits. A custom prompt replaces the profile prompt entirely, so keep the tool-usage and path rules intact.
notes.agentRoot: The Main Agent is a persistent root runtime and takes part in no gates; closing subagents sign off through the tier→gate→role chain. Subagents cannot dispatch further work.
notes.rolePrompt: Leave empty to fall back to the built-in prompt. Read-only subagents still have their approval mode enforced by the registry; a closing subagent must keep the JSON result contract, or ChildResult validation fails.
notes.gateBinding: Each gate has exactly one closing subagent; clicking an already bound one unbinds it.
notes.gateEvidence: Evidence is measured by the host: implementer checks file changes, reviewer checks critical findings, verifier checks command exit codes; any other subagent is only validated on completed + valid. Gates never trust a model's own account.
notes.edgeSemantics: tier→gate edges set the gate order; gate→role edges pick the closing subagent; other connections are informational only.
